title: Archived Solutions Canvas
description: Killed solution leaves — the record of work NOT built, which receipt-render calls the load-bearing honesty of a receipt. Added 2026-09-01: this file was one of seven canvases validate_canvas reported as 'parse-checked only', and it had just acquired a DEPENDENT — check_log_reconcile (v0.155.0) reads `archived[].leaf_id` and nothing guaranteed the field existed. Field set and the `reason` enum are taken from engine/leaf-lifecycle.md's documented archive-entry format rather than inferred from the three entries present, so the schema describes the CONTRACT and not this project's sample of it.

archived.description: Killed leaves, never deleted. engine/leaf-lifecycle.md: 'When a leaf is killed at any phase, it is archived — never deleted.'

leaf_id.description: The solution leaf that was killed. READ BY check_log_reconcile.py, which reconciles this file against cycle-history.yml: an archived leaf with no cycle row is an orphan. That check exists because on 2026-08-31 this file held three dated, reasoned kills while cycle-history reported 0 killed, and nothing compared the two.

opportunity_id.description: The opportunity the leaf sat under.

archived_at_phase.description: Which lifecycle phase it died at, per engine/leaf-lifecycle.md.

reason.description: Why it died. Enum taken VERBATIM from engine/leaf-lifecycle.md's archive-entry format, which is the documented contract; it is not inferred from the three entries present. `low-ice-score` appears there parenthesised and is included so a real kill for that reason is not forced to mislabel itself.

ice_score_at_archive.description: The ICE score the leaf carried when killed — the only record of what was predicted for work that no longer exists. TWO KEY SHAPES ARE PERMITTED AND THAT IS A RECORDED COMPROMISE, NOT AN OVERSIGHT: engine/leaf-lifecycle.md documents `{i, c, e, total}` while the live entries use `{impact, confidence, ease, total}`, and opportunities.yml uses `{impact, confidence, ease, score}`. Pinning one would invalidate real records written in good faith against the other. The divergence is flagged here rather than silently resolved; converging them is a migration, not a schema decision.

evidence_snapshot.description: The evidence as it stood at archival — what was known when the decision was made, not what is known now.

revival_conditions.description: What would have to be true to revive it. A kill without this is a deletion with extra steps.

decision_log_ref.description: Where the kill was reasoned through in the decision log.

segments_checked.description: Which segments were evaluated before the kill.
